items.title: Coding Interview Preparation
items.description: Master algorithmic problem-solving with comprehensive coverage of fundamental data structures, core patterns, trees & graphs, and advanced techniques.

items.title: Consistent Hashing: An Advanced Architectural Guide
items.description: A comprehensive deep dive into consistent hashing, addressing modulo scaling bottlenecks, hash rings, virtual nodes, data replication, interview questions, and real-world implementations.

items.title: CPU Scheduling
items.description: CPU scheduling algorithms, metrics, multilevel queues, real-time scheduling, and how the Linux CFS scheduler works.

items.title: Introduction: The 20-Week DSA Roadmap
items.description: A comprehensive 20-week guide to mastering Data Structures and Algorithms in Java, designed for backend engineers and technical interviews.

items.title: Java String Rotation Programming
items.description: Programming-focused Java interview problems on string rotation checks and transformations.

items.title: Rate Limiting Algorithms
items.description: A comprehensive guide to rate-limiting algorithms, including Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket, Fixed Window, Sliding Window Log, and Sliding Window Counter. Covers workflow mechanics, trade-offs, and distributed scaling.

items.title: Week 1: Arrays, Strings & Prefix Sums
items.description: Master contiguous memory structures in Java, including static arrays and string immutability, and optimize range queries using the Prefix Sum pattern.

items.title: Week 10: Recursion & Backtracking
items.description: Master the art of recursive thinking and the 'Choose-Explore-Unchoose' pattern. Learn to solve complex combinatorial problems like permutations, combinations, and grid-based searches in Java.

items.title: Week 11: Intervals & Sweep Line Algorithms
items.description: Master scheduling problems, overlapping events, and the Sweep Line algorithm. Learn how to efficiently sort and process 2D arrays and objects in Java.

items.title: Week 12: Heaps (Priority Queues) & Greedy Algorithms
items.description: Conclude Phase 3 by mastering dynamic extremum tracking and locally optimal choices. Dive deep into Java's PriorityQueue, Top K patterns, and Greedy state transitions.

items.title: Week 14: Dynamic Programming II (2D)
items.description: Master multi-dimensional Dynamic Programming. Learn to solve Grid Traversals, String Alignments (LCS, Edit Distance), and 2D space optimization in Java.

items.title: Week 15: Advanced Sliding Windows
items.description: Master the variable-size sliding window pattern in Java. Learn to dynamically expand and shrink boundaries to solve complex substring, subarray, and stream processing problems.

items.title: Week 16: Tries (Prefix Trees)
items.description: Master the Trie data structure for lightning-fast string manipulation. Learn to build Autocomplete systems, handle wildcard searches, and optimize multi-word grid searches in Java.

items.title: Week 17: Shortest Paths & MST
items.description: Begin Phase 5 by conquering weighted graphs. Master Dijkstra's Algorithm for finding the shortest path and Prim's Algorithm for building Minimum Spanning Trees in Java.

items.title: Week 18: Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find)
items.description: Master the Disjoint Set Union (DSU) data structure. Learn how to dynamically track connected components and optimize with Path Compression and Union by Rank in Java.

items.title: Week 19: Bit Manipulation & Math
items.description: Shift from high-level data structures to low-level CPU operations. Master XOR properties, Bit Masking, signed vs. unsigned shifts, and core Number Theory in Java.

items.title: Week 2: Two Pointers & Basic Sliding Window
items.description: Master the Two Pointers and fixed-size Sliding Window techniques in Java to optimize nested loops and achieve O(N) time complexity for array and string traversals.

items.title: Week 20: Comprehensive Review & System Design Mappings
items.description: The final week! Synthesize all DSA patterns, map abstract data structures to real-world Java backend systems, and master technical interview communication.

items.title: Week 3: Linked Lists & Fast/Slow Pointers
items.description: Transition from contiguous arrays to node-based data structures. Master reference manipulation, Dummy Nodes, and the Fast & Slow Pointer technique in Java.

items.title: Week 4: Hash Tables & Sets
items.description: Master Hash Maps and Hash Sets in Java. Learn about O(1) lookups, collision resolution, frequency counting, and the equals() and hashCode() contract.

items.title: Week 5: Stacks, Queues & Monotonic Stack
items.description: Transition to Phase 2 by mastering LIFO and FIFO data structures. Learn why to avoid Java's legacy Stack class and dive deep into the highly-tested Monotonic Stack pattern.

items.title: Week 6: Binary Trees & BSTs
items.description: Move from linear to hierarchical data structures. Master Depth-First Search (DFS), Breadth-First Search (BFS), and the properties of Binary Search Trees in Java.

items.title: Week 7: Graph Foundations
items.description: Transition from trees to general networks. Master graph representations, Adjacency Lists, and grid-based DFS/BFS traversals in Java.

items.title: Week 8: Advanced Graph Concepts
items.description: Master Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs), cycle detection in directed graphs, and dependency resolution using Kahn's Algorithm (Topological Sort) in Java.

items.title: Week 9: Binary Search & The Answer Space
items.description: Start Phase 3 by mastering logarithmic time complexity. Learn standard Binary Search, handling rotated arrays, and the advanced "Binary Search on Answer Space" pattern in Java.
